routine.name: Unreplied Emails Needing Attention
routine.description: Every morning, searches the inbox for messages not from the user, filters out anything already replied to or younger than 3 days, then uses a judgment to keep only real, actionable emails (excluding automated/newsletter content). If any remain, sends a single Telegram message listing them, oldest first, with sender, subject, and the date they started waiting. Sends nothing when the list is empty.

judgments.needs_reply: Does this email ask the user something and genuinely need a personal reply (i.e. it's from a real person, not automated, newsletter, or purely informational)?

routine.name: Lembrete diário de aniversários
routine.description: Every morning, checks the Google Calendar "Birthdays" calendar for events happening today or tomorrow, extracts the person's name from the event title, and sends a concise Telegram reminder listing today's and tomorrow's birthdays (skipping the message entirely when there are none). Only the "Birthdays" calendar is considered; other calendars' events (meetings, deploys, etc.) are ignored.
